scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Roll, Auto Farm, Auto Tower & Auto Rebirth
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Anime Dice combines fast Auto Roll, AFK money farming, Auto Tower, Auto Rebirth, and targeted trait and grade rerolls. Automatically manage your plot, collect unit income, upgrade your team, and filter unwanted units from one customizable menu.

AUTO ROLL & AFK FARM

- Total AFK Mode — enable rolling, selling, income collection, and best-unit placement together.
- Fast Auto Roll — customize the delay between roll attempts.
- Stop On Target — stop rolling at your chosen rarity, mutation, or roll count.
- Rare Drop Alerts — receive notifications for your selected rarity and above.
- Auto Collect Money — collect income from your plot with an adjustable interval.
- Auto Use Spins — consume available spin items.
- Auto Use Boosts — select Luck, Income, Damage, Multiplier, or all boost types.

UNITS & INVENTORY

- Auto Equip Best — automatically place your best units on your plot.
- Auto Tower Team — equip your best available tower team.
- Auto Hold Best Unit — hold your highest-income unit.
- Auto Level Up — upgrade plotted units with a target level and money reserve.
- Auto Lock Units — lock units matching your keep filters.
- Auto Sell — sell unwanted units automatically or at a chosen inventory threshold.
- Detailed Keep Filters — preserve selected rarities, mutations, traits, grades, and levels.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from Auto Sell.

AUTO TRAIT & GRADE REROLLS

- Auto Grade Reroll — use available Gems until your selected grade or better appears.
- Auto Trait Reroll — use available reroll items until a selected trait appears.
- Choose individual units and track their reroll history.
- View live grade, trait, mutation, level, and income information.

AUTO TOWER & PROGRESSION

- Auto Tower — run your selected tower with optional automatic restarts.
- Equip your best tower team before each run.
- View estimated difficulty relative to your team.
- Track floors, runs, enemy health, and team status.
- Auto Rebirth — rebirth when the required money conditions are met.
- Auto Buy Dice — purchase the next dice or the best affordable option.
- Auto Buy Upgrades — prioritize Luck, Money, Damage, Health, or mixed upgrades.

TRADING TOOLS

- Automatically send trade requests to a selected player or User ID.
- Filter incoming requests using whitelists, blacklists, and account age.
- Choose offered units, exclusion filters, and maximum units per trade.
- Optional Auto Ready and Confirm.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from outgoing offers.

REWARDS & EXTRAS

- Auto claim eligible daily rewards, offline earnings, group rewards, and completed quests.
- Auto redeem codes from the game’s code list.
- Spend available quest tickets on selected Gems, Trait Rerolls, or Lucky Spins.
- Adjustable WalkSpeed, JumpPower, and Fly speed.
- Infinite Jump, Noclip, and teleport to your plot on respawn.
- Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin, and saved configurations.

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Auto Roll, Sell, Rebirth n More
scripts.features:
The script offers an auto roll feature that continuously rolls dice without manual input. It includes an auto rebirth function that handles prestige or rebirth progression automatically. There is a price monitoring tool that tracks item values and market changes in real time. Players can use an auto upgrade option to purchase improvements as soon as they become available. The tool provides an auto equip feature that automatically selects the best items from inventory. An auto sell function lets players convert unwanted items into currency without manual effort. The interface includes toggle switches to enable or disable each automation module independently. A status display shows which features are currently active and running. All of these tools + more are organized into a single accessible menu for easy control.

Anime Dice, Anime Dice AutoFarm, Anime Dice Auto Farm
